svg.title: Independence audit grouping the five NO-GO grounds into two root assumptions, with breaks one and two under a no-wave-problem root and breaks three, four and five under a single locality theorem root

g.text: ROOT A. The pipeline has no wave problem in it.
3DGS is alpha compositing along a ray. No incident field,
no phase, no omega, no Helmholtz operator.
Break 1
one-sided: a splat's SH
is a vector, a T-matrix
is an operator
Break 2
no wave equation, so
WiRoHSH cures a disease
that is not present
two JOINS of one observation, not two facts
ROOT B. An analytic basis cannot be local.
Identity theorem: a nonzero real-analytic function has no
compact support. Everything below is that, in other clothes.
Break 5, the theorem itself
a clipped splat is exactly the class the basis provably lacks
Break 3, the same fact as GEOMETRY
the annulus excludes the edges; occlusion edges are the content
Break 4, the same fact as ECONOMICS
spatially sparse rewritten in a globally dense basis gets larger
The merge is self-reported, not my inference.
wirohsh-approximation section 3.3: "the domain restriction and the analyticity restriction are the same restriction wearing two hats."
VERDICT: two independent roots, not five. A and B are genuinely independent of each other,
and either alone would close the item. Inside each root, the grounds are one fact restated.
